Introducing Burwell Environmental Division 🌬️ We've brought together our engineering expertise, national service network and manufacturing capability into one dedicated division — built to deliver complete dust, fume and air filtration solutions for Australian industry. From standalone units to fully integrated, centralised systems, we design, engineer and deliver turnkey solutions that capture airborne contaminants at the source, creating safer, cleaner and more productive workplaces. Engineered systems. Australian manufacturing. National service and support. Follow Burwell Environmental Division for updates, or visit burwell.com.au to see the full range. #BurwellEnvironmental #AirPollutionControl #IndustrialSafety #DustControl #FumeExtraction #WHS #AustralianManufacturing
